description: This Java class 'LogWrapper' implements a logging interface by wrapping Android's native Log utility, enabling log messages to be processed or forwarded in a chain of LogNode objects.

classes.name: LogWrapper
classes.description: A class that wraps Android's native Log utility to provide a chainable logging node implementing LogNode interface.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Logs the message using Android's Log class, optionally including an exception trace, and forwards the log to the next node.
